headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty fell as surging crude oil prices led to a 2% weekly decline.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 27 October.

why: Crude oil prices surged to $117 per barrel, weighing on investor sentiment
Heavy selling in benchmark indices led to a 2% weekly decline for Sensex and Nifty
Concerns over the impact of rising energy costs on the Indian economy
Sensex and Nifty snapped their previous winning streaks amid global volatility
whatHappening: AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% jump in Q2 net profit to 858 crore
Adani Enterprises emerged as the top loser in the weekly market wrap
IT stocks saw some buying interest despite the broader market decline
The MCA extended annual filing deadlines and waived extra fees for FY26 filings
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmarks Sensex and Nifty closed lower, ending the week with a 2% loss driven by crude oil prices reaching $117 per barrel. While Adani Enterprises was a top loser, AU Small Finance Bank posted a strong 53% profit growth. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday.
